verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms n8n supports scheduled workflow execution alongside webhook triggers in real production use (n8n-comm-18), and n8n's broader automation/workflow platform framing supports recurring job execution. However, the evidence pack lacks first-party documentation specifically describing the Schedule Trigger/Cron node, cron syntax, timezone handling, or execution history for scheduled runs. Missing for 10: official docs citation for the Schedule/Cron trigger node, details on interval/cron configuration options, and independent confirmation of reliability for long-running recurring jobs.
